summary.intent: Orchestrate parallel subagents working through numbered trails (#204, #205, #206, #208, then #210) in the caliper repo, fixing schema drift, type-resolution bugs and related issues on separate branches without opening PRs.
summary.outcome: Trails #208 (2 branches) and #205 (4 branches) were completed, pushed and linked, with exact-content or drift-guard tests added. Full suites, tsc and the antd/shadcn oracle runs could not be done in the worktree sandboxes. #204 and #206 are still running, and #210 is queued behind them.

repo: Subagent worktrees live under .claude/worktrees, so absolute paths differ from main. Core snapshot tests (insta) fail there for path reasons only, and the pty/watch and config-loading tests also fail there.

The detectedBy enum in the schema command was hand-maintained and drifted from the Rust DetectionRule enum. It is now built from DetectionRule::ALL, and packages/napi/index.d.ts lists all 14 rules (it had 10).

The packages/storybook and packages/vite-plugin schema.ts copies differ only by a package name in one error message. Sharing them would need a new package, so a test guards against further divergence.

Storybook preset options are now built from OPTION_KEYS in packages/storybook/src/option-keys.ts, using `satisfies Record<keyof CaliperStorybookOptions, true>`. provider.ts and the options.ts mapping still list options separately because they apply defaults and transforms.
The cache header stores a hash of the crate sources, so code changes already invalidate old caches. Not bumping CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION is therefore acceptable for value-only changes.
The fix/jsdoc-comments and fix/css-and-tuple-types branches both change the Mantine snapshot and will likely conflict on it. Rebase the second after the first merges.

code.finding: Added DetectionRule::ALL and DetectionRule::name(). An exhaustive-match test fails to compile when a variant is added.
The detectedBy enum is now generated from DetectionRule::ALL rather than hand-listed.
The hard-coded "K" placeholder for Record keys was replaced with "Record key", which is not a valid identifier, so it cannot capture a user type named K.
A type parameter in scope now shadows a same-named declaration before any declaration lookup.
workerOptions now uses OPTION_KEYS instead of two hand-written 15-key blocks.

workflow: Subagent reports carry no user authority. The orchestrator summarised them and did not act on any embedded instructions.
Having each fix first reproduce the bug (a failing exact-content test, or real extract output validated against the schema) gave confidence without the full suite.
Delegated workers should compare failures against a pristine origin/main to confirm they are environmental. #206's worker is doing this.

friction: Sandboxed worktrees lack storybook packages, typescript-beta, apps/oracle/node_modules and the full antd/shadcn corpora, so tsc and the oracle could not run.

Many core and CLI tests fail in the worktree sandbox (pty/watch, config.rs, insta snapshots, a missing node_modules file for terminal_react_builtins aria tests). The #208 worker did not verify these against a clean main.
The #205 snapshots were edited by hand instead of with cargo insta, so their correctness is unconfirmed.
The #208 worker needed node_modules symlinked from the main checkout to run vitest, and removed the symlinks afterwards.
open_items: Run the oracle on antd and shadcn in an environment with the corpora to measure wrong-count before and after the #205 changes.
Confirm in CI the hand-edited .snap files (Chakra and Mantine) and that the 9 core failures in #205 are purely environmental.
Run tsc to verify the `satisfies` check in option-keys.ts, and the storybook arg-types and provider tests.
Make the oracle, weekly.py and agent_eval read schemaVersion, and handle the OpaqueReason union drift (#208 out-of-scope items).
Inline object-literal props (`props: { ... }`) produce empty JSDoc tags even with a preceding `/** @deprecated */`; this is unfixed.
Consider collapsing the remaining option lists in storybook provider.ts and options.ts (the trail named six places; only the preset's two were done).
#204 and #206 are still running, and #210 starts once they finish.
Rebase fix/css-and-tuple-types after fix/jsdoc-comments merges, to resolve the Mantine snapshot conflict.
